newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday said the Bengalee settlers would not be relocated from the hill districts.
Bangladesh Navy personnel impounded a Honduran flag carrying ship after recovering from it smuggled cigarettes worth over 50 million taka, and arrested 11 crew.

Finance Minister S A M S Kibria on Wednesday told the parliament that the present governemnt had to shoulder the legacy of the "anarchy and indiscipline" in the financial sector created during the past BNP government.
Former President Hussain Muhammad Ershad on Wednesday called for a consensus among all political parties and groups on basic national issues.
Deputy Opposition leader Prof Badruddoza Chowdhury on Wednesday urged Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to "rise above jealousy and sycophancy" which he said finished many leaders.
The three-day India-Bangladesh Joint Economic Commission (JEC) meeting which ended in New Delhi on Wednesday resolved to increase the scope and pace of cooperation between the two countries.
Arvind Mills Ltd of India , the world's fifith largst producer of Denim fabric, is going to market its products in Bangladesh.
Kingfisher company of U.K. has expressed interest in setting up a liquor and lager manufacturing plant in the Export Processing Zone in Bangladesh. REUTER
